title: Churchbridge Campground

services.name: Churchbridge Campground
services.desc: Weekly, Monthly and Seasonal Rates must be paid at the beginning of the stay and are non-transferrable and non-refundable. Use of the showers and the Sewer Dump station are no charge for visitors staying at the campground, a charge is only for those that would like to use the amenities as they’re passing through. The Churchbridge Community Campground placed 2nd in Saskatchewan Municipal Awards 2021-2022. Click here > https://youtu.be/Vk7T-plQNSU to watch a video of the campground. NO RESERVATIONS.
